caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a dark brown, worn surface. The chair has a curved and decorated backrest that features carved patterns and appears to have traces of faded green and red painted designs. The seat is solid and also shows significant wear, with lighter areas where the finish has been rubbed off. The legs of the chair are turned, with two horizontal stretchers connecting the front and back legs for added support and stability. The chair sits on a plain, light beige background with no other objects present. The artist’s name, "Angelo Bulone," is written in small letters in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Zoar Chair
